notes.text: The author describes the relative simplicial structure through conditions b₁, b₂ and b₃, and says that it is associated with a local cylindrical stratification of Σ carrying an order on codimension-one strata through x. He then identifies Γ(d) with spaces of germs of codimension d+1 strata and attributes the semi-simplicial applications and the reconstitution of flag spaces to this order. The closing sentence asserts an equivalence involving Γ and Σ and continues beyond this leaf. These are reports of the manuscript; no proof or independent verification of these claims was performed.

The marginal formula has the clearly written asterisk in Γ(n)=Σ*(n+1). The six body occurrences use the compact angular superscript transcribed <. Both written forms are preserved. Their mathematical relationship was not used to alter either reading.

The author’s corrections include cancelled est; the replacement of a cancelled Σ-expression by Γ(d) with an added equality; parties replaced by espaces; the added parenthesized germes de; les replaced by germes; and the cancelled parenthetical grâce à la structure d’ordre. The line-15 cancellation and insertion, line-17 cancellation, line-18 first word, and line-22 abbreviation remain difficult. The literal line-15 = x sequence is retained without supplying any absent word or replacing its two strokes by ∋.

No page number in the main dark hand is visible. The bottom-left 53 is a small, lighter foliation in another unnamed hand and is transcribed as a margin note. H’s page marker and editorial note are not treated as source prose.

All reading decisions on this page were based on inspected letterforms, stroke structure, and the page’s repeated written forms. No mathematical proof-check, re-proof or calculation was undertaken. The repeated highly compressed à was compared with the same form in the cancelled grâce à la structure.

The final proposed text carries the author’s compressed abbreviations and the awkward agreement around l’ens des strates ... sont ordonnés as written, with the ending doubt stated. The proposed live state of semi in line 22 has medium confidence because the dark ink follows the joined letter baseline rather than showing a separately extended crossing stroke.
